title.value: GradMask: Reduce Overfitting by Regularizing Saliency
title.justification: The paper explicitly focuses on introducing the GradMask method to handle overfitting by regularizing saliency in medical imaging.
title.quote: We propose a regularization method, GradMask, which penalizes saliency maps inferred from the classifier gradients when they are not consistent with the lesion segmentation.

analysis.description: This paper introduces GradMask, a novel regularization method aimed at reducing overfitting in models by penalizing incorrect saliency map attributions in the context of medical imaging.

type.justification: The paper includes experimental results, such as AUC scores, to demonstrate the effectiveness of the GradMask method.
type.quote: The experiments aim to demonstrate that the GradMask method decreases overfitting measured by an improvement over the baseline of the test AUC.

name.justification: The focus on medical imaging and saliency maps indicates that this paper is situated within the domain of Computer Vision.
name.quote: Within medical imaging, this can occur when features are incorrectly assigned importance such as distinct hospital specific artifacts, leading to poor performance on a new dataset from a different institution.
